canonical_statement: The deity is the creator of the individual sovereign.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou it was that createdst me

canonical_statement: Political sovereignty is a divine endowment.

attributions.surface_quote: with the sovereignty of a multitude of peoples didst invest me

canonical_statement: The divine nature possesses an inherent quality of omniscience or watchful awareness.

attributions.surface_quote: MERODACH, lord, open-eyed of the gods

canonical_statement: Divine favor is the necessary condition for the endurance and stability of human structures and lineages.

attributions.surface_quote: At thy behest, O merciful MERODACH, may the house I have made therewith endure!

canonical_statement: The exercise of political authority is legitimized through priestly or religious service to the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: sagganakku meant a priestly rather than a secular personage

canonical_statement: The physical world is anchored by a foundational structure that connects heaven and earth.

attributions.surface_quote: The house of the foundation-stone of heaven and earth.

canonical_statement: Pure or right thought is conceptually equivalent to a bright or luminous image.

attributions.surface_quote: ALAM SHIG mean bright or pure image, and so pure, right thought.

canonical_statement: The celestial realm possesses a singular, unified language, contrasting with the multiplicity of human tongues.

attributions.surface_quote: Multae terricolis linguae, coelestibus una.

canonical_statement: There exists a singular, unified language shared by celestial beings, contrasting with the multiplicity of human languages.
